questions.q: Which sentence means 'I go swimming twice a week'?
options: Ich gehe einmal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche tanzen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Monat schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche schwimmen
questions.explain: 'Zweimal pro Woche' = 'twice a week' and 'schwimmen' = 'to swim'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich lese normalerweise abends' mean?
options: I usually read in the evenings
I will read in the evenings
I used to read in the evenings
I have to read in the evenings
questions.explain: 'Normalerweise' means 'usually' and 'abends' = 'in the evenings', so this is 'I usually read in the evenings'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We decorate the Christmas tree'?

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I follow many influencers online'?
questions.explain: 'Folgen' takes the dative, so 'Ich folge vielen Influencern online' (present tense) = 'I follow many influencers online'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester
Ich streite mich mit meiner Schwester
Ich ärgere mich über meine Schwester
questions.explain: 'Sich gut verstehen mit' means 'to get on well with', so this is 'I get on well with my sister'.
